name: worker-conditional-send-test-60862305bc/worker-conditional-send-test-60862305bc-v.bal
spec_references: Statements: supported list includes If/else, Return and Panic, but does not include named worker declarations or worker send statements.
Expressions: "Wait action" is listed; worker receive actions (including alternate and multiple receive) are not listed.
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only "message".
Subset restrictions / Invocations / Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes error:message but not error:detail.
reason: Essential named-worker declarations and conditional worker sends/receives, including alternate and multiple receive and NoMessage channel behavior, are not covered by subset 10. Independently, imported errorLib:NoMessage and e.detail() exceed the explicit lang.error allowlist. Wait, panic, trap and error-message support does not establish support for these worker protocols or their asserted exact NoMessage details.
unsupported_constructs: Named workers and asynchronous worker sends
Worker receive, alternate receive and multiple receive actions
error:detail and exact NoMessage detail/channel behavior
test_design_notes: Mixed supported control flow/wait/error operations with essential unsupported worker communication and lang.error APIs.
The sole @output marker is 0 from io:println before the assertions; it does not itself demonstrate successful completion of the worker assertions. No @args or @panic markers occur.
